Name: Skell's Flowery Weapons
Author: skellady
Description:
[center][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/922475299369783336/1041451212282790020/Illustration2.png[/img]﻿[/center][size=3]
This mod retextures and recolors the weapons to make them look softer + adds vines and flowers.[/size]

[size=4][b]Installation:[/b][/size]

[size=3]1. Install the latest version of [/size][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI
[/url][size=3]2. Install [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher﻿[/url]
[size=3]3. Install the mod (manual download is recommended over vortex/mod managers)[/size]
[size=3]4. Unzip the file and place the folder in your Mods folder[/size]

[size=4][b]See Also:

[/b][/size][size=3]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11104]Skell's Flowery Tools[/url] to match the weapons.
[/size][size=3]- My first weapons mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8246]Slightly Recolored Weapons[/url] if you'd like a version with softer/pastel weapons without the vines and flowers.[/size]

[size=4][b]Configuration:[/b][/size]

[size=3]This mod is highly configurable, which means you can use it alongside other weapons that retexture tools. To do that, I would highly recommend installing [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][size=3]Generic Mod Config Menu[/size][/url].
